name: Buddy
subtitle: Buddy, your AI helper in the Dynamic Island

apps.name: Buddy
apps.subtitle: Ask anything from the Dynamic Island
apps.localizedDescription: Buddy lives in your Dynamic Island. Tap it to ask, or double-tap the back of your iPhone to send a screenshot - the answer appears right in the island while you stay in your app. Free brain, no account.

versions.localizedDescription:
• Windows: talk mode. Press Ctrl+Alt+T, or pick "Talk with Buddy" in the tray menu, and have a spoken conversation without holding a key. Press it again to stop.
• Buddy decides you have finished from your words, not only from a pause. On 192 test clips it was right about 89 to 93 % of the time, against 73 % for a fixed pause. The clips are computer-made voices we built ourselves, not recordings of real people.
• You can interrupt Buddy while it is speaking: start talking and it stops and listens.
• Known limits: on a busy laptop Buddy can take more than a second to notice you have finished (our 0.3 second target is not met yet). There is no echo cancelling, so use a headset in talk mode, or Buddy may hear its own voice.
• Mac: no changes in this version, only the version number.

privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Buddy looks at your latest screenshot only when you ask about it.
